name: app-blue-pixel-capybara-collectible-card-reveal-screen
title: Blue Pixel Capybara Collectible Reveal
whatItIs: A phone screenshot of a year-in-review reveal in navy and periwinkle: a heavy 'DECO' title, a periwinkle collectible card with a level bar and a pixel-art capybara in a swim ring, a black REVEAL button with an offset outline and dashed page progress.
whatItMeans: A single hue in pixel art and hard offset outlines makes a summary feel like unlocking a trading card, playful and rewarding.
techniques: Collectible card with level bar, number and badges
Pixel-art mascot on a dithered gradient
Offset outline on the main button
One hue on a near-black halftone ground

vocabulary.definition: A call to action that unveils a hidden reward.
A pixel pattern that fakes gradients with dots.
An outline shifted behind a shape as a hard shadow.
